summary_en: 3,000,000 ordinary shares (5.97% of shares outstanding) to be cancelled effective August 31, 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares: 47,286,544. Treasury holdings post-cancellation: approximately 388,998 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On August 7, 2026, artience Co., Ltd. announced a board resolution to cancel 3,000,000 ordinary treasury shares effective August 31, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation represents 5.97% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). Following the cancellation, total issued shares will be 47,286,544 and treasury holdings are expected to be approximately 388,998 shares. No purchase price or execution cost is disclosed; the shares are already held in treasury.
